title: “Did you not tell him they are the Lord’s chips?” 😂
body:
Today we welcomed the **Nestlé team** to Rosehill College to work with some of our students through the **Cook for Life programme**.

Our students learned about nutrition and healthy food choices, then got hands-on in the kitchen and put their skills to work. The result? Some very tasty nachos! 🙌

A big thank you to the Nestlé team for supporting our young people to build their cooking confidence and learn practical skills they can take home and share with their whānau. 💚
